codeReview.summary: The AddPane refactor is implemented correctly (command_executor now delegates to shared logic and session recreation uses repo.worktree), but the requested parity test versus the direct wagner.rs path was not actually implemented.

issues.description: Feature description requires a test verifying AddPane through command_executor produces the same result as the direct wagner.rs path. `test_command_executor_add_pane_codex_matches_wagner_path` does not call the direct `Wagner::add_pane_with_engine`/`add_pane` path; it only exercises `execute_cmd` and asserts expected fields, so true cross-path parity is not verified.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The documented lint command in shared state appears incorrect for this environment.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: .factory/services.yaml defines `lint: devbox run cargo clippy --all-features -- -D warnings`, but transcript for workerSessionId 238ddf7d-e994-40ce-b37f-f12c27f6e820 shows this exact form failed with `unknown flag: --all-features`, and worker had to use `devbox run -- cargo clippy --all-features -- -D warnings`.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Validation contract coverage for this feature does not fully encode the feature description's parity requirement.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Feature description explicitly asks for a test comparing command_executor AddPane with direct wagner.rs path, but validation-contract.md for VAL-PANE-006/VAL-PANE-007 only checks delegation and worktree behavior, which allowed a non-comparative test to pass.

summary: Refactor quality is good and behavior-level goals are mostly met, but the explicitly requested direct-path parity test is missing, so this review fails on one blocking requirement gap.
